scope: Scalar conclusions from an already-retained public Xcode snapshot; no new rendering, acquisition, SDK acceptance or legal disposition.

clauses.title: SDK definition
clauses.conclusion_and_limitation: The stated SDK scope includes headers, libraries, source and object code; whether exact objc2 source is covered requires source-generation/material applicability evidence.
clauses.snapshot_clause_statement: The snapshot SDK definition includes designated headers, APIs, libraries, simulators, and source/object code; it does not classify any particular Rust binding.

clauses.title: iOS-family library definition
clauses.conclusion_and_limitation: Do not treat the Application/internal-test permission as a complete iOS-family library distribution disposition; the snapshot points to a separate DPLA.
clauses.snapshot_clause_statement: The Application definition excludes libraries for iOS/watchOS/iPadOS/tvOS/visionOS applications; such libraries can be developed only under DPLA terms.

clauses.title: non-macOS application distribution
clauses.conclusion_and_limitation: Preserves the Section 2.2.B internal/personal-use exception and macOS exclusion. Not a finding that a project distribution breached the agreement.
clauses.snapshot_clause_statement: Except the express Section 2.2B allowance, distribution of Applications developed using Apple SDKs excluding the macOS SDK requires a separate written agreement with Apple.

clauses.title: conditional macOS distribution
clauses.conclusion_and_limitation: The snapshot does not categorically prohibit macOS application/library distribution. Compliance, actual SLA and redistributed SDK/source classifications remain unreviewed.
clauses.snapshot_clause_statement: macOS applications and libraries may be distributed without a separate written agreement only if they comply with this Agreement.

clauses.title: Apple notices in permitted copies
clauses.conclusion_and_limitation: Notice retention is tied to permitted Apple Software copies, with entirety/no-alteration restrictions. This does not decide which notices apply to particular Rust bindings.
clauses.snapshot_clause_statement: Permitted Apple Software copies must retain/reproduce in full Apple copyright, disclaimers and proprietary notices; entire permitted copies, no alteration and separate-SDK-use restrictions remain.

clauses.title: SDK/software redistribution restriction
clauses.conclusion_and_limitation: Apple Software/Services redistribution and downstream sublicensing are not established by a crate SPDX declaration or mere availability of the SDK.
clauses.snapshot_clause_statement: Redistribution or sublicensing of Apple Software/Services, whole or part, is prohibited unless Apple expressly permits it in writing.

clauses.title: source/derivative restrictions and exceptions
clauses.conclusion_and_limitation: Preserve both applicable-law and separately licensed open-source/sample-code exceptions. No exception was assigned to any selected release.
clauses.snapshot_clause_statement: Source/derivative restrictions preserve express permissions, applicable-law limits and separately licensed open-source/sample-code exceptions; no exception is assigned to a crate.

clauses.title: separate update license
clauses.conclusion_and_limitation: An actual SDK/update may have a separate governing license; this public PDF is not a substitute for the version/entity-specific accepted terms.
clauses.snapshot_clause_statement: The Agreement governs Updates unless an Update has a separate accompanying license, in which case that license governs.

clauses.title: generated-code responsibility
clauses.conclusion_and_limitation: The no-ownership-claim sentence retains Apple prior rights and user responsibility for third-party rights/attribution. Not a retroactive applicability decision for SDK-derived 2025/2026 source releases.
clauses.snapshot_clause_statement: Generated content/code remains the user responsibility; the no-ownership claim preserves Apple prior rights, while testing, third-party rights and required attribution remain user responsibilities.

clauses.title: Apple third-party notices
clauses.conclusion_and_limitation: Actual third-party electronic documentation/licenses and redistributed material scope must be identified for the actual SDK. This clause does not say objc2 is GPL/LGPL or complete its contributor notices.
clauses.snapshot_clause_statement: Applicable third-party acknowledgements, terms and disclaimers are in actual electronic documentation and respective terms govern; references to some GPL/LGPL material do not classify objc2.

clauses.title: additional DPLA rights
clauses.conclusion_and_limitation: No DPLA acceptance, entitlement or additional rights were inferred; any relevant separate agreement requires its own exact evidence.
clauses.snapshot_clause_statement: Validly licensed additional DPLA rights/features are governed by that DPLA; this does not establish any actual acceptance or additional right.

notice_distribution_clause_summary.2.5_page4: Retain/reproduce in full Apple notices in permitted copies; entirety and no-alteration conditions remain. Applicability to exact bindings is undecided.
notice_distribution_clause_summary.2.7_page5: Apple Software/Services redistribution or sublicensing requires express permission in writing; preserve applicable-law and separately licensed open-source/sample-code exceptions without assigning one to a crate.
notice_distribution_clause_summary.8.1_page13: Actual electronic third-party documentation and respective terms must be identified; this does not make objc2 GPL/LGPL or supply its contributor notices.
notice_distribution_clause_summary.ios_family_library_boundary: The Application definition excludes iOS/watchOS/iPadOS/tvOS/visionOS libraries and points their development to the DPLA; no actual DPLA acceptance is established.
notice_distribution_clause_summary.macos_distribution_boundary: Section 2.4 permits macOS application/library distribution without a separate written agreement only if compliant with this Agreement; neither a blanket ban nor blanket permission is inferred.
notice_distribution_clause_summary.generated_code_boundary: Section 2.11F preserves Apple prior rights and user responsibility for third-party rights and attribution; no per-release applicability clearance.

required_unresolved_evidence: Original source-generation SDK/version and source-generation provenance for the exact selected releases, or explicit bounded unresolved disposition.
Actual native build Xcode/SDK versions and exact accepted agreement/entity/version evidence; this public snapshot and its PDF producer metadata do not provide them.

Exact redistributed code/headers/libraries/generated materials classified against the applicable SDK terms and separately licensed open-source/sample components, with actual electronic notice documentation.
Any relevant DPLA/additional written permissions and qualified per-release distribution/source/notice disposition.
